About the Scholarship

Imperial's flagship fully funded PhD scheme offers full tuition fees, a stipend of £27,036 per year (2027-28 rate), and a consumables fund.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: President's PhD Scholarships
HostImperial College London
LocationLondon, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
Stipend£27,036/year (2027-28 rate) + £2,000/year consumables fund
Application Deadline30 November 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Funding detail: £27,036 per year (2027-28 rate) + £2,000 per year consumables fund

Basic Information

  • Full Title: President's PhD Scholarships
  • Host Institution: Imperial College London
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 3.5 years
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: £27,036 per year (2027-28 rate)
  • Tuition Fees: Full funding
  • Consumables Fund: £2,000 per year for first 3 years
  • Eligibility: No restrictions on nationality
  • Application Deadline: Multiple rounds: November, January, March

Programme Description

Imperial's flagship fully funded PhD scheme offers full tuition fees, a stipend of £27,036 per year (2027-28 rate), and a consumables fund of £2,000 per year for the first 3 years. The scheme also includes a programme of bespoke opportunities and events delivered by the Early Career Researcher Institute (ECRI).

Eligibility and Requirements

Candidates must be in receipt of, or due to receive, a first class or equivalent in an undergraduate or integrated Masters degree; or a distinction in a standalone Master's qualification.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/postgraduate-doctoral/grants-scholarships/presidents-phd/

Source: imperial.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About Imperial College London

Imperial College London is a public research university focused on science, engineering, medicine and business. Based in London, it offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in these fields. Its academic community combines scientific research with practical applications, working with healthcare, industry and international partners on technological and societal challenges worldwide.

Official website: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Apply to a PhD programme at Imperial and indicate interest in the President's PhD Scholarship by the relevant funding deadline.
